description: Run by the Renovate job on harvest (Forgejo repo adham/renovate). Every pull request goes through CI like any other; merging one is a staging deploy. Patch updates and the grouped npm minor-and-patch pull request merge themselves once CI passes.

packageRules.description: Patch updates of stable versions merge themselves once CI passes: a merge only deploys staging, and prod still waits for promote.

Minor and patch npm updates of stable packages: one pull request a week, merged by Renovate once CI passes. Majors, and 0.x packages where any bump can break, stay one pull request each and wait for you.
Node.js moves as one: the Dockerfile's images, CI's node-version and @types/node, so the types never describe a different runtime.
docker-compose's Postgres is for local development and matches Neon's major version, 17. When Neon's changes, change this limit with it.

Libraries that have broken MediaSafe in a minor release, so never grouped and never automerged: better-auth renamed getIp to getIP and moved @better-auth/core/context in 1.6.x (PR #507), and a squawk-cli minor added a lint rule that fails on already-applied migrations.
